content.title: Will There Be a 'Paradise' Season 3? All About Xavier's Next Mission
content.text: NEED TO KNOW Hulu announced that Paradise was renewed for season 3 on March 17The second season ended with a dramatic finale on March 30Creator Dan Fogelman previously hinted at the third season potentially being the series' last Season 2 of Paradise has come to an end, but a third season is already on the way! The hit Hulu show, which was created by Dan Fogelman, stars Sterling K. Brown as Secret Service agent Xavier Collins investigating ongoing conspiracies in the underground city-sized bunker, Paradise — which was designed as a utopian refuge for elite members of society after an environmental disaster seemingly destroyed the rest of the population. However, the utopian bunker turns out to be anything from perfect when people start going missing and getting mysteriously killed. Season 2 follows Xavier searching for his wife, Teri (Enuka Okuma), outside of the bunker and discovering conspiracies that go far beyond its walls. Season 2 ended with a dramatic finale on March 30, but Disney and Hulu had already confirmed that Paradise would be returning for season 3. While much of the details are under wraps, Fogelman teased to The Hollywood Reporter that the third season may be its last. He told the publication in January 2025 that from the beginning, he thought, "It’s going to be a three-season show, I know where it goes. I know what the shape of each season is. I’m going to go rewrite the pilot just to accommodate a little bit of that." Here's everything to know about Paradise season 3. What will Paradise season 3 be about? Percy Daggs IV, Sterling K. Brown, and Aliyah Mastin in Paradise. Brian Roedel/Disney On March 17, Disney and Hulu announced that Paradise was renewed for season 3. The season 2 finale, titled "Exodus," includes several flashbacks that finally reveal who Alex is. As it turns out, "Alex," is the name of professor Henry Miller's (Patrick Fischler) wife, played by Gwen Holloway, who was suffering from Huntington's Disease. It's later revealed that Alex died, so Henry honored her legacy by creating an "AI-controlled quantum computer" with Link (Thomas Doherty). The powerful computer, called Alex, can "predict anything that can go wrong in the future in microseconds." However, the computer may have worked too well and become too successful, which caused both Henry and Link to fear it, especially when they learn that the machine is "trying to manipulate time" and create different timelines. At the same time they're debating what to do with Alex, Xavier and Teri return to Paradise just when it's starting to collapse from oxygen failure. The only way to save the beloved bunker is to activate the evacuation protocol "Exodus," which leads to utter chaos. In the final moments, Paradise figurehead Sinatra (Julianne Nicholson) has a flashback during which she discovers that Link is actually her grown son, Dylan, whom she thought died in season 1. She tells Link, a.k.a. Dylan, that he is her son and later pays the ultimate sacrifice for him. In order to save the population from the nuclear reactions that would explode along with Paradise, someone needs to stay inside and lock the doors, so Sinatra volunteers and is killed in the explosion. Before she dies, she tells Xavier that there is a second bunker underneath the Denver Airport where Alex is located. She tells him that Alex "can stop all of this" and predict how to save the population. The final moments show Xavier arriving to the second bunker and pondering how Alex will change everything. An official synopsis for season 3 has not been released but it will most likely include revelations about this second bunker and Alex. Who is in the cast of Paradise season 3? Sterling K. Brown in Paradise. Gilles Mingasson/Disney The cast for season 3 of Paradise has not been announced. However, the Disney press site teased that the third season will continue to star Brown. In addition to Brown, the season 2 cast also included Nicholson, Sarah Shahi, Nicole Brydon Bloom, Krys Marshall, Okuma, Aliyah Mastin, Percy Daggs IV and Charlie Evans. James Marsden, Shailene Woodley, Doherty and Jon Beavers also made guest appearances. While the series hasn't confirmed any returning or new cast members for season 3, there are a decent amount of characters who died during season 2. Nicholson's character, Sinatra, appeared to die by sacrificing herself to save everyone else. However, Sinatra's death isn't the only shocking one. Anders (Erik Svedberg-Zelman), the bunker's architect, and Geiger (Michael McGrady,) Link's close friend, are also killed in an explosion. Earlier on in the season, Woodley's character, Annie, died in childbirth. Meanwhile, Secret Service agent Jane Driscoll (Brydon Bloom) was shockingly murdered by Dr. Gabriela Torabi (Shahi) in the seventh episode. Now, though, that it is clear time can be manipulated, deceased characters may have a chance to return. When is Paradise season 3 coming out? Erik Svedberg-Zelman, Julianne Nicholson and James Marsden in Paradise. Ser Baffo/Disney Paradise season 3 was renewed on March 17, but a premiere date has not been announced. Season 1 filmed in the spring of 2024 and premiered in January 2025, while season 2 filmed from March through August 2025 with a February 2026 release date. The show has not announced when filming for season 3 will begin, but Brown said he believed they'd be behind the camera from March to August 2026, per his podcast, That Was Us. Where can I watch Paradise? Sarah Shahi, Jonathan Tanigaki, and Nicole Brydon Bloom in Paradise. Ser Baffo/Disney Seasons 1 and 2 of Paradise are available to stream on Hulu and Disney+.
